svg.text: Expert parallel beats tensor for MoE
Route sparse tokens with all-to-all instead of slicing dense matmuls thinner.
why EP over TP for MoE
TP cuts matmuls finer: small tiles, GPU utilization suffers.
EP routes tokens to whole experts: matmuls stay big.
all-to-all dispatch; load balance keeps it near a transpose.
DeepSeek DeepEP, NVIDIA Hybrid EP: latency is everything.
EP parallelizes MLPs, not attention. Decouple: high TP for attention, low TP for MoE layers.
Source: lecture expert-parallel slides, original plate. Shell 5: MoE changes the prescription.
